notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 28 p. 518: "The fourth German assault against the Seventh Army began in earnest on 7 January along the vulnerable northern portion of the Lauterbourg salient"; "Decker's XXXIX Panzer Corps arrived to control the operation, with both armored divisions and the 245th Volksgrenadier Division in support". Event definition: the start of the assault on 7 January. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Lauterbourg with a precision of 10 km, the name CMH gives to the salient where the attack began; the corps headquarters place is not named. Location approximate: the salient area for a corps attack. Location support: CMH names the northern portion of the Lauterbourg salient. Commander: General der Panzertruppen Karl Decker. Opponents: US Seventh Army (VI Corps).

notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 28 p. 521: "Decker's breakthrough to Hatten and Rittershoffen, about noon on the 9th"; p. 520: "The heaviest fighting was concentrated in the two small Alsatian towns of Rittershoffen and Hatten, both just north of the Haguenau forest". Event definition: about noon on 9 January. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location support: CMH names Hatten and Rittershoffen. Commander: General der Panzertruppen Karl Decker. Opponents: US 14th Armored Division and 79th Infantry Division.
